description: Welcome to AstroNova AI! I'm a B.Tech CSE student at IIIT Nagpur, passionate about AI, full-stack development, and space exploration. Our team aims to build an engaging solution for NASA's Earth Information Jukebox challenge using open Earth science data. We're seeking teammates with skills in AI/ML, coding, data analysis, visualization, UI/UX design, and Earth science. Beginners are welcome too! Join us to collaborate, learn, and create a meaningful project for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.!!!
